role: Software Developer responsible for ASP.NET Web Application development, feature implementation, bug fixing, UAT support, deployment support, maintenance, and production issue investigation for logistics and import-export workflows.

sections.title: Project Context
sections.body: This work supports enterprise logistics and import-export operations. The application helps business users process operational workflows and documents that connect with logistics requirements and Thai Customs NSW-related processes.

sections.title: Application Development
sections.body: I developed and maintained ASP.NET Web Application features using C#, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL, HTML, and CSS. Work included implementing new features, modifying existing screens, fixing bugs, and supporting long-term system maintenance.

sections.title: Integration And Operations
sections.body: The work involved business workflow integration with Thai Customs NSW-related processes, support for UAT, deployment coordination, and investigation of production issues reported by users.
